description: Bounds the task queue read (docs/AUDIT_TOKEN_EFFICIENCY.md F9: consumer project A's docs/TASK_QUEUE.md at 191 rows / 27KB is the specific object the post-mortem names, and CONTEXT_BUDGET_POLICY.md's 'query the canonical queue for non-terminal entries only' is prose applied only after the file is already open and billed). hooks/queue-briefing.sh now resolves a project's declared queue location (the execution-assets 'Canonical locations' override, scanned only in the annotated zone immediately after that marker's END, preferring a single unambiguous non-archive *queue*.md match and falling back to the tasks/QUEUE.md default otherwise -- a wrong resolution with no error is worse than the default), and for governed-SDD's table format resolves which QUEUED rows are actually startable (every dependency ACCEPTED, or ANSWERED for a SPIKE per task-lifecycle v2) versus blocked on an unmet one, reading a dependency's status from QUEUE_ARCHIVE.md too when present. `queue-briefing v1` in docs/CONTEXT_BUDGET_POLICY.md points a session at this resolved summary as the normal path, naming the conditions that still justify opening the file directly. The hook itself runs from $CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT, not a per-project copy, so every project sees the new briefing output immediately regardless of its own locked VERSION; only the policy text explaining it arrives on upgrade to 1.1.23.
delta: In docs/CONTEXT_BUDGET_POLICY.md: a new capability=queue-briefing v1 marker is added as item 5 of the existing 'Task-first loading' numbered list, pointing at the queue briefing as the normal path and naming when opening the queue file directly is still justified. In templates/workflows/governed-sdd/tasks/QUEUE.md (not a managed/marker-protected file -- this is bootstrap-time seed content, so listing it here is documentary only and an already-adopted project's own queue file is unaffected): an 'Archiving' paragraph documents moving ACCEPTED rows to tasks/QUEUE_ARCHIVE.md, mirroring Lean Delivery's existing convention. hooks/queue-briefing.sh (framework tooling, no per-project copy) gains queue-location resolution and dependency-aware ready/blocked classification for the governed-SDD branch; the Lean Delivery branch is unchanged.
verification: docs/CONTEXT_BUDGET_POLICY.md carries a MERIDIAN:BEGIN capability=queue-briefing v1 marker inside the Task-first loading section
templates/workflows/governed-sdd/tasks/QUEUE.md documents archiving ACCEPTED rows to tasks/QUEUE_ARCHIVE.md
hooks/queue-briefing.sh resolves a project's declared queue location from PROJECT_WORKFLOW.md's execution-assets annotation zone, falling back to tasks/QUEUE.md on no match or ambiguity

hooks/queue-briefing.sh classifies governed-SDD QUEUED rows as startable or dependency-blocked, treating ANSWERED as satisfying a dependency without counting it toward the ACCEPTED tally, and reads QUEUE_ARCHIVE.md for dependency status when present
hooks/queue-briefing.sh completes well within its 5s hook timeout on a 200-row governed-SDD queue
